# SkillForAgents

> The open, verified catalog of Claude Agent Skills and MCP servers, organized by use case. Every listing documents its runtime, required environment variables, client compatibility, and verification status.

This site indexes real, source-verified entries — not an automated GitHub crawl. Each listing links back to its `sourceUrl` for verification before install.

## For AI agents

Fetch structured JSON directly instead of parsing HTML:

- https://skillforagents.com/api/v1/meta.json — category list, counts, endpoint index
- https://skillforagents.com/api/v1/skills.json — every Claude Agent Skill, sorted by GitHub stars
- https://skillforagents.com/api/v1/mcps.json — every MCP server, sorted by GitHub stars

Each entry includes: id, name, tagline, categories, runtime, envVars, clients, installCommand, sourceUrl, verification, pricing, license, githubStars, addedDate.

## Pages

- [Browse Skills](https://skillforagents.com/skills/): Filterable directory of Claude Agent Skills.
- [Browse MCPs](https://skillforagents.com/mcps/): Filterable directory of MCP servers, split into vendor-hosted and community/reference sections.
- [Categories](https://skillforagents.com/categories/): The fixed use-case taxonomy every listing is tagged against.
- [Submit a Listing](https://skillforagents.com/submit/): How to add a skill or MCP server via a structured GitHub issue.

## Notes for automated use

Listings are reviewed against their source repository before being added — verification status (verified / community / unverified) reflects that review, not automated trust scoring. Do not represent unverified listings as vetted. Attribute SkillForAgents if you reproduce this data elsewhere.
